title: 第4章 先天三窍第5章 舍命守护
content_zh:
小伦，同样不遑多让，它乃纯火体，而其本命真火之尊贵，就连掌控火之本源，而且是先天火玄体的三师父祝燚，也不见得在它之上。
在炼化了一枚癸水蛟魔核之后，小伦意外的铸造了水火变异体。
并且，他的境界同样达到了淬元境大圆满，距离聚元境只有一步之遥。
它没有经脉障碍，这一步之遥，显然要比肖恩轻松得多。
当目光望向出现在视线内的那片赤红的大地时，肖恩的眼神也是跟着这片大地的温度而炽热起来。
这里，将会是他最后一种火之本源壮大之地。
进入这座山谷，温度越来越高，小伦前蹦后蹿，就像是个宠坏了的孩子似的。
肖恩知道小伦天生会对火属性亲近，既然是小伦开心，便任由得它尽情的玩耍，只是一双眼睛警惕的巡视着四周。
四面全部都是干秃秃的大山，能够在火焰中生长的植物少之又少。
整座山谷尽是熊熊燃烧着的火焰，就像是一座火焰谷，越往前走温度就越高。
不过，这一次却是出奇的顺利，途中没有遇上任何的魔兽，肖恩和小伦来到了一个火山谷，一棵火红的参天大树拔地而起。
火红的树干，火红的树叶，远远的看着，就像是一团深红色的火焰在舞动，树上结着两枚同样是火红色的朱果。
“火睛树，火睛果！”
看见这两枚朱果，虽然不是能壮大火之本源的玄材，但却没有失望，反而是笑得更加的开心，肖恩知道它的价值绝对不在本源玄材之下。
等肖恩将两枚火睛果摘下来的时候，火眼树便开始下沉，直至没入到了地下。
当火眼树完全的没入到了地下的一刻，四周的山谷竟然开始熔化，渐渐的熔化成了岩浆，变成了一片熔岩火海。
“或者，我的先天心窍又再可以开启一窍了！”
对于出现在四周的熔岩火海，肖恩一脸平静，不过，当望着手中的火睛果时，眼内却是完全被炽热弥漫。
他不知道别人身上会不会诞生先天心窍，只知道每一个先天心窍的诞生，都会令到他拥有一种神秘莫测的力量。
“小伦，把它吃了！”

肖恩将一枚火睛果抛给了小伦，小伦纵身一跃，接住了火睛果吞进了肚子里，然后蹿进了肖恩的怀里，呼呼的沉睡了过去。
肖恩从师父的口中知道，强大的魔兽在服食天材地宝时一般的都是靠沉睡来炼化吸收，天赋越高的魔兽越容易进入沉睡状态。
但沉睡的时候同样的会是魔兽最危险的时候，完全的丧失了自我保护的能力。
如果是这世上只有一个人能够让小伦去信任的话，这个人无疑就是肖恩了，只要是在肖恩的身边，就算是天塌了下来，小伦也是照样的呼呼大睡。
当然，肖恩也从来没有让小伦失望过！
抱着小伦，肖恩盘腿坐在那火眼树下沉的火眼上，同时把火睛果丢进了嘴里，一股精纯的能量顿时在体内炸开。
嗡！
随着火睛果能量的涌入，就像一条蛟龙，直接涌入心宫之内，一道炽热如剑的光芒，隐隐的埋藏在肖恩深幽的眸内。
而在肖恩张开双眼的时候，眼球中呈现出一种红色的的光芒，而瞳孔却是金色的。
此刻肖恩见到的事和物已经和以前完全的的不一样了，目光中仿佛有着一种穿透力，能够将所有能看到的东西往更深的层次看，多出了一种剖析的能力。
这一霎，隐藏在火眼下的火睛树，同样是发着阵阵欢鸣，化为小树苗扎根于肖恩心宫内。
此刻的心宫中，又再多出了一个闪烁着红色光芒的小孔，散发出一种仿佛能够洞悉万物的神秘之感。
“见窍！”
content_en:
Xiao Lun is no less generous. It is a pure fire body, and its true fire is so noble that even Zhu Yi, the third master who controls the origin of fire and is an innate fire mysterious body, may not be above it.
After refining a Guishui dragon demon core, Xiao Lun accidentally created a water-fire mutant.
Moreover, his realm has also reached the Great Perfection of Que Yuan Realm, which is only one step away from Ju Yuan Realm.
It has no meridian obstruction, and this step is obviously much easier than Sean's.
When looking at the red land that appeared in his sight, Sean's eyes also became hot with the temperature of the land.
This will be the place where his last source of fire grows.
Entering this valley, the temperature is getting higher and higher, and Xiao Lun is jumping up and down like a spoiled child.
Sean knew that Xiao Lun was naturally close to the fire attribute. Since Xiao Lun was happy, he allowed it to play as much as it wanted, with only a pair of eyes patrolling the surroundings vigilantly.
There are huge dry mountains on all sides, and there are very few plants that can grow in the flames.
The entire valley is filled with blazing flames, like a valley of flames. The further you go, the higher the temperature becomes.
However, this time it was surprisingly smooth. They did not encounter any monsters on the way. Sean and Xiao Lun came to a volcanic valley, where a flaming red towering tree rose from the ground.
The fiery red trunk and fiery red leaves look like a crimson flame dancing from a distance. There are two fiery red fruits on the tree.
"Fire Eye Tree, Fire Eye Fruit!"
Seeing these two red fruits, although they were not mystical materials that could strengthen the origin of fire, they were not disappointed. Instead, they smiled even more happily. Xiao En knew that their value was definitely not inferior to the origin of mystical materials.
When Sean picked off the two fire-eye fruits, the fire-eye tree began to sink until it was submerged underground.
When the Fire Eye Tree was completely submerged into the ground, the surrounding valleys began to melt, gradually melting into magma and turning into a sea of ​​lava and fire.
"Or maybe my innate mind can be opened again!"
Sean looked calm about the sea of lava and fire that appeared around him. However, when he looked at the Fire Eye Fruit in his hand, his eyes were completely filled with heat.
He didn't know if innate mind orifices would be born in other people. He only knew that the birth of each innate mind orifice would give him a mysterious power.
"Xiao Lun, eat it!"
Sean threw a fire eye fruit to Xiao Lun. Xiao Lun jumped up, caught the fire eye fruit and swallowed it in his stomach. Then he jumped into Sean's arms and fell into a deep sleep.
Sean knew from his master's mouth that when powerful monsters consume heavenly materials and earthly treasures, they generally rely on sleeping to refine and absorb them. The more talented monsters are, the easier it is for them to enter a sleeping state.
But when sleeping, Warcraft is also at its most dangerous, completely losing its ability to protect itself.
If there is only one person in the world that Xiao Lun can trust, this person is undoubtedly Sean. As long as he is by Sean's side, Xiao Lun will still sleep soundly even if the sky falls.
Of course, Sean has never let Xiao Lun down!
Holding Xiao Lun in his arms, Sean sat cross-legged on the sunken fire eye of the fire eye tree. At the same time, he threw the fire eye fruit into his mouth, and a pure energy exploded in his body.
Buzz!
With the influx of Fire Eye Fruit energy, like a dragon, it poured directly into the heart palace, and a blazing sword-like light was faintly buried in Sean's deep eyes.
When Sean opened his eyes, there was a red light in the eyeballs, but the pupils were golden.
At this moment, the things that Sean saw were completely different from before. There seemed to be a penetrating power in his eyes, which allowed him to see everything he could see at a deeper level, giving him the ability to analyze.
This moment, hiddenThe Fire-Eyed Tree under the fire's eyes also roared with joy, turning into a sapling and taking root in Sean's heart.
At this moment, there is another small hole shining with red light in the heart palace, exuding a mysterious feeling that seems to be able to penetrate all things.
"See the clues!"
